mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectSidocodeList */ ARCODE, AR_FULL_NM AS ARNAME, SDCODE FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE ARLEVEL = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectSidocodeList */ ARCODE, AR_FULL_NM AS ARNAME, SDCODE FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE ARLEVEL = 2 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND SDCODE = #{sdcode}

SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBatchTagetFile */ BATCHNO AS BTNO , BT_UUID AS BTUUID , BT_EXCO AS BTEXCO , BT_FILENM AS BTFILENM FROM TB_CM_BATCHJOB WHERE BATCHTY = 'BJT000' AND BT_STTUS_CD = 'BTS002' AND BT_EXCO > 0 AND BT_FILENM = CONCAT('SP-', #{jobid}, '-', BT_UUID, '.txt') ORDER BY BATCHNO DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBatchJobListCount */ COUNT(1) AS T_CNT FROM TB_CM_BATCHJOB WHERE DATE_FORMAT(BT_ST_DT, '%Y%m%d') >= #{btstDe}

SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBatchJobList */ BATCHNO AS BATCHNO , BT_UUID AS UUID , BATCHTY AS BATCH_TY , BT_STTUS_CD AS BT_STTUSCD , DATE_FORMAT(BT_ST_DT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i:%s') AS BTST_DT , DATE_FORMAT(BT_ED_DT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i:%s') AS BTED_DT , NVL(BT_EXCO, 0) AS BT_EXCO , BT_FILENM AS BT_FILENM , BT_ERROR_MSG AS BT_ERRORMSG FROM TB_CM_BATCHJOB WHERE DATE_FORMAT(BT_ST_DT, '%Y%m%d') >= #{btstDe} ORDER BY BATCHNO DESC LIMIT #{stno}, #{edno}
SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectComplexCpxgno */ LPAD(NVL(MAX(CPXGNO), 0) + 1, 4, 0) AS CPXGNO FROM TB_BD_COMPLEX A WHERE CPXNO = #{cpxno}
